modules.title: 自己注册和第三方授权，两条登录路径

example.label: 授权与登录返回的结果

steps.label: OAuth：访问资源授权
steps.demo:
files.example.com · 授权页

允许“照片整理站”查看相册？

权限范围：读取相册　　不允许：删除照片

用户同意 · 返回 access token（限定范围）
steps.caption: OAuth 让用户授权客户端按范围访问受保护资源。access token 是访问凭据，不是通用的用户身份凭据。

steps.label: OAuth 本身不证明用户身份
steps.demo:
照片整理站 · 返回页
收到access token
可用于按获准范围访问相册 API
用户身份不能仅凭 OAuth access token 判断
steps.caption: 客户端获得资源访问授权，不等于已经知道用户是谁。不能把 access token 当成登录身份凭据。

steps.label: 用 OpenID Connect 登录
steps.demo:
accounts.example.com · OpenID Connect
返回凭据ID token · 身份声明
本站处理验证后查找或建立本站用户
结果用户进入本站账户
steps.caption: 网站要用提供方账号登录时，通常使用构建在 OAuth 2.0 之上的 OpenID Connect；验证身份信息后，网站仍需映射到自己的用户记录。

modules.title: OAuth 授权后客户端拿到什么

items.title: 跳到第三方确认
items.text: 点击“用微信登录”后跳到微信的授权页；用户在自己熟悉的平台确认同意。

items.title: 带着结果回到本站
items.text: 同意后跳回网站，网站拿到的是授权结果；整个过程不接触用户的微信密码。

items.title: 本站仍要识别用户
items.text: 网站用自己的用户记录认出“是谁”；OAuth 负责资源授权，不等于身份认证，也不替代本站账号系统。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: OAuth 不是登录身份协议。要接第三方登录，需确认提供方的身份机制和本站用户映射；授权撤回或服务故障时，按产品需要提供其他登录方式。

lessonPractice.title: 产品要加第三方账号登录，同时保留邮箱注册。接入前要确认什么？

options.label: 授权之外还要确认提供方身份机制，并把身份映射到本站用户
options.feedback: 对。OAuth 授权不单独证明用户是谁；登录还要验证提供方身份，并映射到本站用户。邮箱注册可以并存。

options.label: 接了 OAuth 就不需要任何账号系统了
options.feedback: 网站仍需自己的用户记录来识别“是谁”；OAuth 只负责授权确认这一步。

options.label: 用户把微信密码告诉网站即可登录
options.feedback: OAuth 的意义正是网站不接触第三方密码；授权后只拿到结果，不拿到密码。

en.title: The product wants third-party sign-in but will keep email registration. What should be confirmed first?

options.label: Confirm the provider identity mechanism as well as authorization, then map that identity to the site user
options.feedback: Correct. OAuth authorization alone does not prove who the user is; sign-in also needs provider identity verification and a mapping to the site user. Email registration can coexist.

options.label: Once OAuth is added, no account system is needed at all
options.feedback: The site still needs its own user records to identify who is who; OAuth only handles the authorization confirmation step.

options.label: The user tells the site their WeChat password to sign in
options.feedback: The point of OAuth is that the site never touches third-party passwords; after authorization it only gets the result.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请在登录页增加第三方登录入口。先确认提供方使用 OpenID Connect 还是官方身份接口；配置授权回调后验证身份，再匹配或创建本站用户。邮箱注册保持不变，并说明如何验收登录结果与失败提示。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Add a third-party sign-in option. First confirm whether the provider uses OpenID Connect or its official identity API; configure the authorization callback, verify the identity, and then match or create a site user. Keep email registration unchanged and explain how to verify successful sign-in and failure messages.

learning.assumes: You have seen sign in with WeChat / Google buttons, or used third-party sign-in yourself.
learning.outcome: You can distinguish OAuth resource authorization from the identity verification needed for third-party sign-in.

modules.title: Self-registration and third-party authorization: two sign-in paths

steps.label: OAuth: authorize resource access
steps.demo:
files.example.com · Authorization

Allow Photo Organizer to view your albums?

Scope: read albums　　Not allowed: delete photos

User approves · returns a scoped access token
steps.caption: OAuth lets a user authorize a client to access a protected resource within a scope. An access token is an access credential, not generic proof of user identity.

steps.label: OAuth alone does not prove identity
steps.demo:
Photo Organizer · Return page
Receivedaccess token
Can use it toCall the album API within its scope
User identityCannot be inferred from OAuth access token alone
steps.caption: The client receives authorization to access a resource; that does not identify the user. An access token should not be treated as a sign-in identity credential.

steps.label: Sign in with OpenID Connect
steps.demo:
accounts.example.com · OpenID Connect
Returned credentialID token · identity claims
Site actionValidate, then find or create its own user
ResultUser enters the site's account
steps.caption: A site that signs in through a provider account commonly uses OpenID Connect, built on OAuth 2.0. After validating identity claims, the site still maps the person to its own user record.

modules.title: What the client receives after OAuth authorization

items.title: Jump to the third party to confirm
items.text: Clicking sign in with WeChat jumps to WeChat's authorization page; the user approves on a platform they know.

items.title: Return with the result
items.text: After approval you return to the site with an authorization result; the whole flow never touches the user's WeChat password.

items.title: The site still identifies the user
items.text: The site uses its own user records to recognize who this is; OAuth grants resource access; it is not authentication and does not replace the site's account system.

modules.title: What it does not guarantee
modules.text: OAuth is not a sign-in identity protocol. For provider sign-in, confirm the provider identity mechanism and map it to the site user; provide another sign-in path if the product requires it when authorization is revoked or the provider is unavailable.

distinctions.label: Authentication
distinctions.text: Authentication confirms a user's identity; OAuth authorizes a client to access resources and does not by itself define a generic sign-in identity. Third-party sign-in commonly uses OpenID Connect or a provider identity mechanism.

distinctions.label: Password sign-in
distinctions.text: Self-registration makes users remember a new password; OAuth can authorize a client to access a resource, but authorization alone does not establish the user's identity.
